obernants.domain: Deterministic successful Rust test runs on named bounded fixtures; no claims for unexecuted cases.
obernants.operator: Within deterministic terminating test executions, a pass is excluded when any executed assertion is false; failure is excluded when all assertions hold. Untested inputs are outside this observation.
obernants.assumptions: Stable Eq semantics where relevant; successful allocation; ordinary Rust execution.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact mathematical target; finite evidence does not establish a universal proof.
